title: Avoid redundant memory reads while reliably recovering governing rules
outcome: Agents retrieve governing rules and relevant task memories without repeatedly loading unchanged bodies already present in their current context.
acceptance: Define when current-context content can be reused and when compaction, replacement or a revision change requires fresh retrieval; advertisement flags alone never prove a body was read.
Deliver a compact governing entry point and task-specific retrieval procedure, including continuation discovery and explicit handling of failed reads or missing context.

Validate unchanged-context reuse, changed rules and post-compaction recovery with representative source-backed examples demonstrating less redundant retrieval and correct recovery of applicable rules; optional byte counts may support the comparison, and instruction changes follow existing authority requirements.

completion.summary: Delivered compact guidance navigation, safe unchanged-context memory reuse, and source-backed recovery examples; all acceptance criteria passed independently.
